description: Entering the sacred state by making intention and wearing the prescribed clothing.

duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayk lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna al-ḥamda wa'n-ni'mata laka wa'l-mulk, lā sharīka lak

description: Circumambulating the Ka'bah seven times in an anti-clockwise direction.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā 'adhāb an-nār

description: Walking seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwa.

duas.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Inna aṣ-Ṣafā wa'l-Marwata min sha'ā'ir Allāh

description: Pilgrims travel to Mina and spend the day and night in preparation for Arafah.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra hādhā al-yawm

description: Standing (Wuquf) at the plain of Arafah from noon until sunset - the essential pillar of Hajj.

duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Allāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu'l-mulku wa lahu'l-ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr

description: After sunset at Arafah, pilgrims travel to Muzdalifah to pray and collect pebbles for stoning.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاهْدِنِي السَّبِيلَ الْأَقْوَمَ

description: Throwing pebbles at three stone pillars representing Satan's temptations.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَبْرُورًا وَسَعْيًا مَشْكُورًا وَذَنْبًا مَغْفُورًا
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma'j'alhu ḥajjan mabrūran wa sa'yan mashkūran wa dhanban maghfūran

description: Offering a sacrifice to Allah, commemorating Ibrahim's willingness to sacrifice Ismail.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَلَكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāhi wa Allāhu Akbar, Allāhumma hādhā minka wa lak

description: Men shave their heads completely (Halq) or trim the hair; women cut a fingertip's length.

duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى مَا هَدَانَا وَأَنْعَمَ عَلَيْنَا
duas.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi 'alā mā hadānā wa an'ama 'alaynā

description: The essential Tawaf performed after leaving Mina, also known as Tawaf al-Ziyarah.
